Hero_Desc_Cuee:
Kyuri is a 'cucumber enthusiast' sprite who puts cucumbers in her food.
She is trying to make cucumbers a mainstream food within Sprite society, but it seems like a lost cause, considering how divisive they are.
Album_Wish_Cuee: For Sprites to learn to love cucumbers
Album_Cuee7: Watching Kyuri, I realized how remarkable it was to love something so deeply. When I impulsively patted her head, she blushed and presented me with an enormous pile of cucumbers.
LoveHero_Cuee:
We're going to
spread cucumbers
around the world!
LoveHeroCancel_Cuee:
But I dreamt of a
cucumber empire...
Food_ChefNote_Cuee_Hate1: She frowned and said that using frying to draw out an ingredient's sweetness was not the proper method.
Food_ChefNote_Cuee_Hate2: She left it unfinished, saying the smell of gunpowder overwhelmed the refreshing aroma of cucumber.
Food_ChefNote_Cuee_Like1: She chewed it thoroughly, saying she could smell something similar to cucumber.
Food_ChefNote_Cuee_Like2: Saying she needed no drink, she happily alternated bites of strawberry cake and cucumber. Her tastes remain a mystery.
Food_ChefNote_Cuee_Like3: She finished the entire bowl, amused by the chewy texture, and suggested adding cucumber as a garnish.
Food_ChefNote_Cuee_Like4: Even while proposing all sorts of ideas for making a cake like this from cucumbers, her hands never stopped devouring the cake.
Food_ChefNote_Cuee_Like5: She enjoyed the tart flavor, saying it would make an excellent dressing if sprinkled over cucumbers.
Food_ChefNote_Cuee_Like6: She stubbornly insisted that although it was already delicious, using cucumber as the filling would certainly make it more popular.
Food_ChefNote_Cuee_Like7: Saying she wanted to enjoy sweetness like this occasionally, she closed her eyes in bliss as she ate.
Food_ChefNote_Cuee_Like8: She ate every last bite, saying the slightly sweet and tart flavor supplied nutrients that cucumbers lacked.
Food_ChefNote_Cuee_Like9: She suggested producing candies themed after various vegetables. This was after she had eaten all the candy.
Gacha_Result_SpecialLine1_Cuee: Oh? Is this how I make my entrance?
Gacha_Result_Line1_Cuee: Well color me cucumber! Have I kept you waiting?
Cuee_Growth: Kyuri, devoted to the one true path of cucumbers!
Cuee_Growth1: This is the power of cucumbers.
Cuee_Victory1: Eat cucumbers, turn them into paste, apply them... but never throw them away.
Cuee_Defeat1: I need to water my cucumber garden...
Cuee_Affinity1_1: Would you like a cucumber? I can give you two!
Cuee_Affinity1_2: I wish every sprite would eat cucumbers.
Cuee_Affinity2: Did you know cucumbers have many relatives? Cucumbers are amazing!
Cuee_Affinity1_3: Ah, the crisp bite of a cucumber! Nothing is better, right?
Cuee_Affinity3: Seeing cucumbers hanging in bunches fills me with pride.
Cuee_Affinity4: It is disrespectful to waste even a cucumber's peel!
Cuee_Affinity5: You dislike cucumbers? Why not keep feeding them to you until you like them?
Cuee_Affinity6: Snails live among cucumber vines. Troublesome creatures.
Cuee_Affinity7: I am cucumber, and cucumber is me! It is my identity!
Cuee_LevelUp: I got stronger! Just as I expected!
Cuee_HeroUpgrade: It's all thanks to the varied cucumber diet.
Cuee_Touch1: It's okay. Cucumbers help with skin elasticity.
Cuee_Touch1_1: Apply cucumber oil after every pinch!
Cuee_Touch1_2: It's firm and stretchy, isn't it?
Cuee_Touch2: Gotta dill with it... I mean, this feels good!
Cuee_Anger4: I do not care for it.
Cuee_Pleasure5: This is fun, is it not?
Cuee_Gacha2: Hey, hey. Were you waiting for me?
Cuee_Gacha3: Oh? Is this how I make my entrance?
Cuee_Line1: Try using cucumber oil. It is good for your skin.
Cuee_Line3: A basketful of cool, delicious cucumbers!
Cuee_Lobby: You dislike cucumbers? I keep telling you to try one.
Cuee_ThemeBattle01: The guard captain who resembles a steamed bun... No, it is the other way around. What, this is delicious!
Cuee_ThemeBattle02: This book tastes like bread. So that is why I liked books.
Cuee_ThemeBattle03: Cucumber, cucumber, cucumber! Dipping a cucumber in this makes me feel completely reconciled!
LoveLetter_Cuee:
Cucumber, cucumber~ Hello, Master! It is Kyuri! I recommend cucumbers to many friends, but I simply have to recommend them even more strongly to you.

First, you are always suffering under a crushing workload, are you not? A cucumber facial will make your skin firm again! And carrying sliced cucumbers to eat will replenish any missing moisture!

Please take my advice and help make cucumbers popular throughout the Sprite Kingdom! Cucumber, cucumber~!
LoveCall_Cuee:
Hello, Master?
Would you like a box of fresh cucumbers? This harvest is in excellent condition!
Perhaps that is why you immediately came to mind! Cucumber, cucumber!
It has been a while since I saw you... so I will deliver them myself later!
Ah! While I am there, I can give you a cucumber facial too. How does that sound?
Slice the fresh cucumbers nice and thin, then place them right on your face...
And you can feel all their fragrance and freshness directly! Cucumbeeer!

Hmm... It has been a while since my last cucumber facial too. Shall we do it together?
May I stay at the Order for a little while?
I want to take this opportunity to talk about cucumbers with you all night!
I will even teach you piles of cucumber recipes nobody else knows!
Would one box be enough? I should check.
Ah, this is exciting! See you later, Master! Cucumber, cucumber!
Affinity_Cuee_EP01_001: Everyone likes only strawberry cake. Cucumber cake is delicious too...
Affinity_Cuee_EP01_003: That is true. Still, if I recommend it diligently, surely they will try it at least once?
Affinity_Cuee_EP01_004: Do not play games with food.
Affinity_Cuee_EP01_007: Even if it does not, once I create it, it will exist!
Affinity_Cuee_EP02_001: I like the scent of earth and rain. The scent that rises when a field becomes wet.
Affinity_Cuee_EP02_002: You sounded remarkably like a farmer just now.
Affinity_Cuee_EP02_003: This must be what people call a true calling.
Affinity_Cuee_EP02_004: I love the smell of magic shells in the morning.
Affinity_Cuee_EP02_005: What are you talking about? You cannot use magic, Master.
Affinity_Cuee_EP02_006: I like that scent too. It makes me feel surrounded by nature.
Affinity_Cuee_EP02_007: You understand! It makes one feel healthier!
Affinity_Cuee_EP03_001: Everyone else must possess wishes of their own too, correct?
Affinity_Cuee_EP03_002: They are all written in the album.
Affinity_Cuee_EP03_003: What? That sounds somewhat frightening... Are you collecting information about the Apostles without permission?
Affinity_Cuee_EP03_004: I hope every wish comes true.
Affinity_Cuee_EP03_005: So do I. A world in which everyone eats cucumbers would be a happy one.
Affinity_Cuee_EP03_006: Are you not curious about my wish?
Affinity_Cuee_EP03_007: Hmm... I do not know. That the Apostles stop causing trouble?
Affinity_Cuee_EP04_001: Cuke, cuke~! Master, I believed in you!
Affinity_Cuee_EP04_002: What are you suddenly talking about?
Affinity_Cuee_EP04_003: Does the Order not survive upon faith? It is like a greeting.
Affinity_Cuee_EP04_004: Cuke! I gladly accept your faith!
Affinity_Cuee_EP04_005: Cuke, cuke~! You truly understand, Master!
Affinity_Cuee_EP04_006: That manner of speaking is far too intense.
Affinity_Cuee_EP04_007: Tch. Would it hurt you to play along?
Affinity_Cuee_EP05_001: I am the developer of this month's most popular Monatium convenience-store dessert: cucumber jelly!
Affinity_Cuee_EP05_002: So you created that accursed food.
Affinity_Cuee_EP05_003: Accursed?! I created that recipe with all my devotion and love!
Affinity_Cuee_EP05_004: What sort of place is the Monatium convenience store...?
Affinity_Cuee_EP05_005: Hmm? You have never visited? When you do, remember to buy my cucumber jelly!
Affinity_Cuee_EP05_006: xXionx said it sells exceptionally well.
Affinity_Cuee_EP05_007: Hehe... Cucumbers find an audience everywhere.
Affinity_Cuee_EP06_001: If I grew something besides cucumbers, what should I grow?
Affinity_Cuee_EP06_003: No. One must not casually steal another person's identity.
Affinity_Cuee_EP06_004: You should grow yourselves taller first.
Affinity_Cuee_EP06_005: Are you showing off merely because you are somewhat tall?
Affinity_Cuee_EP06_006: You should remain devoted solely to cucumbers.
Affinity_Cuee_EP06_007: That must be right. You truly are wise, Master!
Affinity_Cuee_EP07_001: I dislike snails, but butterflies are adorable, so they may visit the field.
Affinity_Cuee_EP07_002: Indeed. Butterflies and bees are needed for pollination.
Affinity_Cuee_EP07_003: Oh... You know rather a great deal, Master.
Affinity_Cuee_EP07_004: I shall never forget... the grudge of the snails.
Affinity_Cuee_EP07_005: What? Do you possess some sort of connection with them, Master?
Affinity_Cuee_EP07_006: May the Feedistance visit the field too?
Affinity_Cuee_EP07_007: No, those friends are somewhat... At least the snails do not devastate the entire field.
Affinity_Cuee_EP08_001: Is there no way to correct the Fairies' eating habits?
Affinity_Cuee_EP08_002: Perhaps feeding them cucumbers would change their constitution.
Affinity_Cuee_EP08_003: Oh... What an intriguing thought. Would they become healthier and eat fewer sweets?
Affinity_Cuee_EP08_004: Report to me first if you discover a method.
Affinity_Cuee_EP08_005: You will provide proper compensation, correct?
Affinity_Cuee_EP08_006: You are the unusual one. Why force everyone to match your standards?
Affinity_Cuee_EP08_007: That is cruel! You also search for other food because you tire of the Fairy diet, Master!
Affinity_Cuee_EP09_001: Everyone calls me stubborn... but I actually possess conviction.
Affinity_Cuee_EP09_002: What is the difference between stubbornness and conviction?
Affinity_Cuee_EP09_003: Hmm... Explaining it aloud is difficult... Um...
Affinity_Cuee_EP09_004: Well, you could not live that way without conviction.
Affinity_Cuee_EP09_005: Exactly! I am fighting a lonely battle!
Affinity_Cuee_EP09_006: If there is con-viction, are there also horse-viction and pig-viction?
Affinity_Cuee_EP10_001: Yesterday, I dreamed of an enormous cucumber. It seemed to be telling me something...
Affinity_Cuee_EP10_002: Have cucumbers become divine beings now?
Affinity_Cuee_EP10_003: The World Tree exists. Why could a World Cucumber not exist too?
Affinity_Cuee_EP10_005: I do not know. Thinking about it makes my head hurt.
Affinity_Cuee_EP10_006: It was merely a meaningless dream because you like cucumbers.
Affinity_Cuee_EP10_007: You must be right. I worried for nothing.
Affinity_Cuee_EP11_001: It seems Karen argued with her sister again.
Affinity_Cuee_EP11_002: Be careful not to become caught in the crossfire.
Affinity_Cuee_EP11_003: I appreciate your concern... but is that not rather cold?
Affinity_Cuee_EP11_004: As her friend, comfort her properly.
Affinity_Cuee_EP11_005: Yes. I was already on my way back from making cucumber salad and eating it with her.
Affinity_Cuee_EP11_006: Are you gossiping about your friend behind her back?
Affinity_Cuee_EP11_007: N-No! Must you make everything difficult to say?!
Affinity_Cuee_EP12_001: This weekend's Mass was the worst.
Affinity_Cuee_EP12_002: Why? Did Ner do something this week?
Affinity_Cuee_EP12_003: No. The problem was that she did nothing. It was the same as always and utterly boring.
Affinity_Cuee_EP12_005: She said it was a hymn for you, Master, but then played a trot song! Well, it was somewhat amusing.
Affinity_Cuee_EP12_007: Why are pumpkins our friends? Cucumbers, perhaps, but pumpkins?!
Affinity_Cuee_EP13_001: It must be wonderful to possess such tremendous authority, Master.
Affinity_Cuee_EP13_002: Tell me discreetly if there is something you want.
Affinity_Cuee_EP13_003: Truly? Surely you already know what I want, Master?
Affinity_Cuee_EP13_004: Honestly, I have never exercised my authority either...
Affinity_Cuee_EP13_005: What? If not the Master, who exercises authority? The High Priest after all?
Affinity_Cuee_EP13_006: I command you: You shall wash the dishes.
Affinity_Cuee_EP13_007: What? Is that any way to treat a guest?
Affinity_Cuee_EP14_001: Adding cucumber slices makes herbal tea refreshing!
Affinity_Cuee_EP14_003: Shall I brew some now? I always carry cucumbers in preparation for moments like this.
Affinity_Cuee_EP14_004: Drink mint tea from the beginning.
Affinity_Cuee_EP14_005: Being refreshing is not the point. Adding cucumber slices is the point!
Affinity_Cuee_EP14_006: You have recipes of your own.
Affinity_Cuee_EP14_007: This is far from the only one! I could explain cucumber recipes all day!
Affinity_Cuee_EP15_001: Of all numbers, I like 52 best.
Affinity_Cuee_EP15_002: The number of white keys on a piano and weeks in a year.
Affinity_Cuee_EP15_005: Number jokes possess a long and distinguished tradition!
Affinity_Cuee_EP15_006: Fifty-two... Joined together, the digits rather resemble a heart.
Affinity_Cuee_EP15_007: Oh... Do they? Thanks to you, I have another reason to like it!
Affinity_Cuee_EP16_001: Do you have any tastes that others fail to understand, Master?
Affinity_Cuee_EP16_002: The Apostles could never fail to understand me.
Affinity_Cuee_EP16_003: Come now, Master. Do you not trust us a little too much?
Affinity_Cuee_EP16_005: What was that?! I just felt a chill.
Affinity_Cuee_EP16_007: ...It certainly hurts a little. Well, because you enjoy it, I will allow it.
Affinity_Cuee_EP17_001: Have you ever made a wish upon a shooting star? I have!
Affinity_Cuee_EP17_003: Yes... Probably? I think things worked out well.
Affinity_Cuee_EP17_004: I do not believe in such superstition.
Affinity_Cuee_EP17_005: You have no sense of romance. Do you not think you take life too seriously?
Affinity_Cuee_EP17_007: W-What?! It is merely a superstition! Is forbidding even this not too much?
Affinity_Cuee_EP18_001: I cannot tolerate spicy food well.
Affinity_Cuee_EP18_002: Neither can I. It gives me hiccups.
Affinity_Cuee_EP18_003: Exactly. It numbs the tongue... and makes one sweat terribly...
Affinity_Cuee_EP18_004: One cucumber after spicy food would make it all disappear, would it not?
Affinity_Cuee_EP18_005: Indeed! Cucumbers truly are useful for everything!
Affinity_Cuee_EP18_006: Weakling. Your special training begins today.
Affinity_Cuee_EP18_007: Aaaah! Put down that hot sauce!
Affinity_Cuee_EP19_001: Did you know cucumbers produce flowers too?
Affinity_Cuee_EP19_002: Really? May I visit your field sometime?
Affinity_Cuee_EP19_003: Yes! Of course. When you visit, I will pick several cucumbers for you!
Affinity_Cuee_EP19_004: My head has no room to store such information.
Affinity_Cuee_EP19_005: That merely means your head has limited capacity, Master.
Affinity_Cuee_EP19_006: I had no idea... What do they look like?
Affinity_Cuee_EP19_007: They are yellow and beautiful, shaped like little stars!
Affinity_Cuee_EP20_001: I admit I covet the expensive farming machinery sold in Monatium.
Affinity_Cuee_EP20_002: Do you want one because you know how to use it?
Affinity_Cuee_EP20_003: I must possess it before I can learn!
Affinity_Cuee_EP20_004: Which machine do you want most?
Affinity_Cuee_EP20_005: They have a machine that harvests automatically! The cucumber field is vast, so harvesting is no easy task.
Affinity_Cuee_EP20_006: Shall I introduce you to Elena?
Affinity_Cuee_EP20_007: Oh! If you introduce me, the Elves will not try to swindle me, correct?
